title: Pays for window lists the customers A to Z with a line and Close
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose name starts with a letter after customer C's, and whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, whose name starts with a letter before customer A's, and whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's page.
  2. Click the "Pays for" counter.
  3. Click "Close".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "Pays for" counter shows 2.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "[customer B's name] pays for" opens.
  • It lists customer C first, then customer A (A to Z).
  • Each name is a link.
  • It shows the line "These customers bill new work orders and part sales to [customer B's name] by default."
  • It has a "Close" button.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and customer B's page stays open.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.
